new_jobs.title: Senior Central Operations Manager (APAC Delivery - Consumer Core Experience)
new_jobs.jd: **The team** APAC Central Operations **champions the region’s strategic priorities** by partnering with Local, Global, and Product teams to inform and deliver a **high-impact product strategy** and **drive operational excellence** across all our regional markets. We are a **high-impact, agile team** that thrives in a unique region of diverse, dynamic markets, embracing complexity to drive innovative, localised strategies. Our mission moves beyond BAUs and coordination, focusing instead on ruthlessly **picking the highest-leverage battles** to **drive maximum regional impact** . We utilise a streamlined structure to elevate market-level decision-making, ensuring rapid, high-quality planning and launches. Our work is underpinned by three core pillars: championing incremental technological improvements for long-term growth; fostering collaborative expertise among domain experts; and ensuring effective global coordination for seamless collaboration with all partners. **What You’ll Do** For the Senior Strategy and Operations role, you are responsible for **developing, advocating for, and stewarding the APAC Delivery strategy.** Your impact is balanced between global execution and regional advocacy: * Strategic Stewardship: You will move to an "always-on" planning mindset, influencing the global product roadmap and scoping by leveraging APAC thought leadership. * Operational Excellence: You will transform APAC performance by maximising investment efficiency and designing sharp, data-backed regional strategies aligned to market maturity and competitive intensity. Champion knowledge transfer across markets and distill regional complexity into strategic priorities that influence global direction and strengthen regional capability. * Knowledge Leadership: Be a trusted source of product knowledge. You will foster knowledge sharing between APAC markets and Product, ensuring the quick adoption of best practices and best-practice settings across our stack. * High-Stakes Coordination: You will assist with coordinating multi-market and high risk escalations, ensuring a clear and consolidated view of the product plan for APAC market, Legal and other XFN teams. * Market Nuance: You will understand and assess market-level nuances to product launches and configurations, sharing findings to ensure our "Global First" operating model is continuously refined. **The Domain — Consumer: Shopping & Ordering** The Core Consumer Experience domain focuses on making shopping and ordering seamless, intuitive and rewarding across OFD, Grocery and Retail. Building on the consumer discovery journey, this domain owns the regional strategy and operational excellence of core shopping, transaction and post-order experiences. The objective is to remove friction, improve basket building and conversion, and strengthen consumer trust and engagement through scalable Product capabilities. **Key Areas Of Ownership Include** * Search: Improve search relevance, usability and conversion across verticals, reflecting different consumer missions and category needs. * Bundling & Basket Building: Drive adoption and optimisation of Add-ons and Post-Checkout Bundling (PCB), unlocking incremental orders and basket growth through more seamless shopping experiences. * Loyalty UX: Identify opportunities to improve merchant level loyalty discovery and engagement within core consumer journeys, extending relevant capabilities across OFD, Grocery and Retail in partnership with Merchant teams. * Shopping & Order Experience: Improve the end-to-end journey across shopping, checkout, fulfillment, post-order and quality experiences, reducing consumer friction and strengthening reliability and trust. * Category-Specific Experiences: Champion differentiated consumer needs across categories such as Pharma and Alcohol, ensuring core Product capabilities support category-specific shopping behaviours and regulatory requirements. Success in this role means translating consumer insights into meaningful Product improvements that drive incremental growth, improve the consumer experience and create scalable solutions across APAC markets. **What You’ll Need** We are looking for a Domain Expert who thrives in a lean, high-output environment. * Experience: 4+ years in Product Owner (consumer facing), GTM, or Operational roles. You should have a 'knack for bringing innovative ideas to your work' while maintaining a collaborative approach. * Analytical Rigour: Ability to proficiently analyse data using SQL and advanced Excel to derive actionable insights and provide valuable recommendations. * Strategic Influence: Experience in harmonising themes from market-level forums to ensure strategic priority alignment. You can 'distill the noise' into a coordinated regional voice. * Strategic Prioritisation: Possessing a 'super power' in ruthless prioritisation, with the ability to manage complex trade-offs and focus resources and time on the highest-leverage regional growth initiatives. * Project Management: Demonstrated skills in organisation and stakeholder management, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously without compromising quality. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

new_jobs.title: Regional Commercial Leader, Environment and Process Monitoring - APJ
Foundry Capacity Planning
new_jobs.jd: **Job Description** The Strategic Planning position is responsible for developing long-term external FE capacity plans and strategies to support onsemi's growth objectives. This role partners closely with Business Units, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams to understand capacity requirements and proactively secure manufacturing capacity with external foundries. The successful candidate will analyze forecast trends, evaluate capacity constraints, assess supply risks, and recommend strategies that ensure adequate wafer capacity is available to meet future business needs. This role requires strong analytical skills, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and external partners. **Responsibilities** **Long term Capacity Strategy Development** * Identify future capacity gaps, bottlenecks, and supply risks across key technologies platforms. * Perform capacity scenario analysis to support business growth plans * Develop strategic plans to secure sufficient manufacturing capacity in alignment with business objectives. * Recommend sourcing, allocation, and capacity reservation strategies with foundry partners. * Evaluate alternate sourcing and capacity expansion opportunities to support future demand growth. * Support development of long-term capacity agreements and strategic partnerships. **Cross-Functional Collaboration** * Partner with Business Units, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Finance teams. * Drive data-driven decisions through analytical insights and strategic recommendations. * Collaborate with sourcing and operation team to understand key suppliers capability, capacity roadmaps, expansion plans, and constraints. * Support negotiations and discussions related to long-term capacity planning and supply assurance. **Analysis & Reporting** * Develop dashboards and reports tracking demand, capacity utilization, supply coverage, and risk exposure. * Analyze forecast and capacity requirements across multiple planning horizons. * Assess capacity-related risks across the external manufacturing network. Identify potential supply constraints and develop mitigation strategies. * Support annual operating plans and long-range strategic planning activities. * Provide recommendations based on data analysis, industry trends, and business priorities. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or related field. * 10+ years of experience in supply chain, capacity planning, or semiconductor manufacturing. Technical background can be a plus * Experience working with semiconductor foundries with knowledge of manufacturing process, cycle time, supply chain, etc. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data. * Proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools especially with AI. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to influence decisions in a cross-functional environment. **About Us** **onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. **More details about our company benefits can be found here:** https://www.onsemi.com/careers/career-benefits **About The Team** We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work.

new_jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Networking Ethernet - NVIS
new_jobs.jd: NVIDIA is looking for Senior Networking (ETH/IB) Solutions Architect to join its NVIDIA Infrastructure Specialist Team. Academic and commercial groups around the world are using NVIDIA products to revolutionize deep learning and data analytics, and to power data centers. Join the team building many of the largest and fastest AI/HPC systems in the world! We are looking for someone with the ability to work on a dynamic customer focused team that requires excellent interpersonal skills. This role will be interacting with customers, partners and internal teams, to analyze, define and implement large scale Networking projects. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of Networking, System Design and Automation and being the face to the customer! **What You'll Be Doing** * Primary responsibilities will include building AI/HPC infrastructure for new and existing customers. * Support operational and reliability aspects of large-scale AI clusters, focusing on performance at scale, real-time monitoring, logging, and alerting. * Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and refinement. * Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency, and overall system health. * Provide feedback to internal teams such as opening bugs, documenting workarounds, and suggesting improvements. **What We Need To See** * BS/MS/PhD or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related fields. At least 5+ years of professional experience in networking fundamentals, TCP/IP stack, and data center architecture * Proficiency in configuring, testing, validating, and resolving issues in LAN and InfiniBand networks, especially in medium to large-scale HPC/AI environments. * Advanced knowledge of EVPN, BGP, OSPF, VXLAN protocols. * Hands-on experience with network switch/router platforms like Cumulus Linux, SONiC, IOS, JunosOS, and EOS. * Extensive experience delivering automated network provisioning solutions using tools like Ansible, Salt, and Python. * Ability to develop CI/CD pipelines for network operations. * Strong focus on customer needs and satisfaction. Self-motivated with leadership skills to work collaboratively with customers and internal teams. Strong written, verbal, and listening skills in English are essential. Willingness to travel, around 30% **Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd** * Familiarity with cloud networks (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus. * Linux or Networking Certifications. * Experience with High-performance computing architectures. new_jobs.jd: 好樂目前服務的客戶涵蓋潮流時尚、美妝醫美、運動與生活消費等產業，我們正尋找累積豐富行銷公關實戰經驗，渴望更寬廣的舞台發揮領導才能的工作者！ 作為整合行銷副理／經理，將肩負策略規劃與團隊管理的責任，負責從策略擬定、提案爭取至專案執行、效益評估，帶領團隊為多元產業客戶提供全方位整合行銷解決方案。 我們尋求具備成熟專業、有領導力和業務拓展思維的資深人才，共同開創事業新格局。 如果你嫻熟整合行銷策略與專案管理，也渴望挑戰多元產業客戶，這個職位將會是累積經驗和職涯躍升的助力！ 如有意加入好樂成為我們的夥伴， 請點選以下連結投遞履歷， 並於履歷中附上1至2個過往主責及帶領團隊執行的案例 https://www.104.com.tw/job/6v4xs?jobsource=company\_job 【工作內容】 ➤策略規劃與提案領導： －獨立或帶領團隊進行市場分析、產業趨勢洞察，擬定具前瞻性的整合行銷策略，並主導提案方向與內容產製 －對焦客戶需求，精準掌握痛點，提出客製化解決方案，並帶領團隊完成高品質提案簡報與比稿 －參與業務開發，拓展新客戶，維護與深化既有客戶關係，提升客戶滿意度與專案續約率 ➤專案管理與團隊領導： －統籌專案啟動、資源分配、進度控管、品質監督，確保專案如期、如質、如預算完成 －領導專案團隊，有效分工，激勵團隊士氣，提升團隊整體效能與專業能力 －因應專案需求擔任對外窗口，負責重要客戶溝通與媒體關係維護，建立專業信賴感 ➤效益評估與績效提升： －定期追蹤、分析專案數據，監督結案報告內容，並提出優化建議 －持續關注市場變化與行銷趨勢，精進服務與作業流程，提升團隊競爭力 －參與小組營運規劃與策略擬定，協助提升整體營運績效與成長 【必備條件】 ➤五年以上實務經驗，具備紮實的專案企劃與執行能力 ➤具備策略思考、市場分析、提案簡報、客戶經營、團隊領導等專業技能 ➤優異的溝通表達、簡報提案、談判協商能力 ➤熟悉行銷傳播產業生態與市場脈動 【加分條件】 ➤具備整合行銷、公關、廣告等代理商之工作經歷 ➤具備服務多元產業客戶之經驗 (尤其運動、生活消費、時尚等尤佳) ➤對娛樂、時尚產業具備高度敏銳度 ➤熟悉或具備數位行銷工具與平台操作經驗 ➤具備優異的英文溝通能力 ➤具備業務開發與客戶拓展經驗 【語文條件】英文聽說讀寫精通 【薪資待遇】面議 【工作地點】台北市信義區(捷運101站步行約5分鐘)

new_jobs.title: Sr. Product Designer
new_jobs.jd: **About AIFIAN** AIFIAN is an AI-powered retail platform that bridges the gap between wanting something and knowing exactly what to buy. Shopping for complex products shouldn't feel like a research project. We're building a buying agent that replaces the stress of guessing with the confidence of a trusted recommendation. It's the precision of a personal shopper with the speed of an algorithm. We are changing the game from 'Browse & Hope' to 'Describe & Decide.' You provide the context — who it's for, the occasion, your budget — and our AI does the work. It narrows the world down to two curated options and sources the product for you. We don't hand you a catalog and wish you luck. We act as the knowledgeable friend who says 'trust me, this one' — and get it delivered to your door. **About the Role** AIFIAN is seeking a **Senior Product Designer** to join our mission to innovate and streamline real-world asset investment globally. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in every stage of product development—from brainstorming the next big idea to collaborating with engineering and product management teams to bring it to life. We’re looking for a designer who thrives on learning and is passionate about crafting exceptional user experiences. You excel at translating abstract concepts into tangible deliverables such as complex workflows, wireframes, user interface designs, interaction models, and prototypes. With a deep understanding of the latest web and mobile app technologies, you approach design with a user-centered mindset, always considering the impact on functionality and usability. You are detail-oriented, comfortable working with technical teams, adept at leveraging data to inform decisions, and thrive in fast-paced environments. **What You'll Do** * Design wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals using tools like Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD. * Own the design process for a product area, managing end-to-end design for key features to ensure they meet both user needs and business objectives. * Conduct user research and usability testing to guide design decisions and deliver seamless user experiences. * Develop user-centered designs informed by market analysis, customer feedback, user research, and technical opportunities or constraints. * Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and growth teams to align design strategies with business goals. * Communicate design rationale and decisions effectively to stakeholders, building consensus and inspiring confidence in your vision. * Stay informed about industry trends and best practices to continually enhance product design and user experience. **Traits for Success** * You embrace challenging the status quo and excel at solving complex problems. * You are a proactive self-starter with a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences. * You prioritize the customer experience while balancing design vision with business objectives. * You welcome constructive feedback and contribute thoughtfully to team discussions. * You stay curious and continually seek opportunities to learn about the latest design trends and technologies. **What We Look For** * Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * A minimum of 5 years of experience in product design, with a focus on growth and user engagement. * Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD. * Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Product Managers and Software Engineers. * Proven experience leading complex projects, delivering high-quality designs on time. * Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, for articulating ideas and fostering alignment across teams. * A portfolio showcasing your best work, with a focus on driving growth and delivering impactful user experiences.

new_jobs.title: Advertising Producer
new_jobs.jd: Advertising Creative Producer (AI Video) Full-time | Taipei, Taiwan | Hybrid Monthly salary: NT$40,000–70,000, depending on relevant skills and experience. Can you explain why an ad works—and turn your own ideas into finished work? We are looking for someone with hands-on advertising creative and production experience to create commercial video content with AI. The founder has built a pipeline that automatically tracks trending topics online. You will help select topics, develop concepts, run production and refine the results, connecting timely ideas to a product, brand and audience. WHAT YOU WILL DO • Identify promising angles in online trends, culture and advertising references, and judge their relevance to a product or brand. • Define the audience, core message and product benefits; develop advertising concepts, copy, scripts and storyboards. • Use the existing AI production workflow to generate image, video and audio assets, taking part in testing, selection, revision and finishing. • Review product accuracy, visual consistency, storytelling, pacing and sound. Keep improving the work until it is ready to deliver. • Help manage day-to-day production progress, assets and versions. Document useful methods and recurring problems, and work with the founder to improve the pipeline. • Deliver within deadlines and approved budgets. Recommend additional tools or resources with a clear rationale, cost estimate and test plan. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR • Practical experience in advertising creative, copywriting, branded content or commercial video production, with clear examples of your own contribution and decisions. • The ability to turn product benefits into engaging visual stories and explain how your creative choices serve the audience and message. • A willingness to produce, test and revise work yourself, with high standards and openness to feedback. • Curiosity about online culture, trends and new ways to create, combined with judgment about what fits a brand. • Active learning, resourcefulness and clear communication about progress, obstacles and support needed. AI generation and editing experience is helpful. Mastery of every tool is not required. The founder can help you learn how to combine AI tools; we value how you use them to improve the work. WORK ARRANGEMENT This is a Taipei-based hybrid role. More time at our office in Da’an District will be required during the initial period. When working remotely, you must be able to attend the office with one day’s notice. WHAT TO SHARE WHEN APPLYING Share your resume and examples that demonstrate your advertising creativity and production judgment: commercials, brand videos, social ads, pitches or personal projects.
